picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, a whole-of-government initiative launched by executive order and joined by 15+ federal agencies, signals the broadest coordinated U.S. policy push yet to embed AI into scientific discovery infrastructure.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30 more makes it one of the single largest concentrations of DOE AI-for-science funding awarded this cycle, spanning materials, energy, and computing.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge National Laboratory leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 more cements its position as a central hub for AI-driven scientific computing at national-lab scale.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's selection to lead six projects and partner on 17 others under Genesis Mission reflects deep integration of AI, HPC, and quantum computing across the national lab's core defense and energy research mission.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20M NSF award to lead an AI-enabled 'programmable cloud laboratory' node establishes new automated-science infrastructure that could reshape how experimental research is conducted nationally.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: Boston University's $20M NSF award to help build a 20-node national 'cloud lab' network is a major infrastructure investment aimed at democratizing remote, AI-driven automated experimentation.
picks.title: NSF Awards Boston University $20 Million to Help Create National “Cloud Lab” Network

picks.editorial_note: The release of Apertus 1.5 by EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS advances a rare fully open, multimodal large language model trained on European supercomputing infrastructure, a notable counterweight to closed commercial models.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's participation in CuspAI's global AI Materials Foundry links academic research to an international, industry-led network accelerating AI-driven materials discovery and robotic experimentation.
picks.title: Cambridge researchers contribute to AI Materials Foundry

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT's expanded AI and robotics partnership, backed by Bavarian government funding, deepens transatlantic academic collaboration through embedded faculty exchanges between MIRMI and CSAIL.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's launch of the Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program marks a significant Japanese national push to build generative AI foundation models and autonomous research agents for scientific discovery.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)
